provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: at the same time as; the moment (that)
while also being; and at once
patterns.usage_note: Marks two things holding at once: an event coinciding with another (ドアが閉まると同時に, the instant the doors shut), or two properties held together (医師であると同時に母, 美しいと同時に力強い). A bare event noun attaches directly (卒業と同時に); である is needed only for the dual-property reading. It is more formal than とすぐに and carries no surprise, so the second event may be planned.

examples.ruby: ドアが閉[し]まると同時[どうじ]に、電車[でんしゃ]はゆっくり動[うご]き出[だ]した。
examples.english: The moment the doors shut, the train began to pull away.

examples.ruby: 叔母[おば]は外科医[げかい]であると同時[どうじ]に、二人[ふたり]の母[はは]でもある。
examples.english: My aunt is a surgeon and, at the same time, a mother of two.

examples.ruby: 大会[たいかい]が開幕[かいまく]すると同時[どうじ]に、街[まち]の空気[くうき]が変[か]わった。
examples.english: The instant the tournament opened, the whole mood of the town changed.
